limitations: 旧12findings重新核查；固定Git Go原件核ACP普通/!输入、Agent采样/工具/权限/结果、预算观测和checkpoint文件发布/会话恢复；未全审2737文件、全部工具/OS沙箱/网络/进程树/前端；未重用旧DSH caller作为当前依赖验收。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 根DeepSeek Reasonix是独立编码Agent/Studio/CLI，提供终端、桌面、Web和ACP编辑器接入；本条身份为root工具，不能将integrations/dsh-plugin的0.1.0当根版本或称整仓DSH原生插件。README区分Studio2.x开发线和npm1.x维护线，根构建有Go1.26/toolchain要求；固定Git源码不等当前发布包/宿主安装通过。
[Q02](#research-q02)普通ACP→模型Stream→干净提交→工具Execute→按id结果回流循环；[Q03](#research-q03)!走单独用户shell。
旧12findings重新核查；固定Git Go原件核ACP普通/!输入、Agent采样/工具/权限/结果、预算观测和checkpoint文件发布/会话恢复；未全审2737文件、全部工具/OS沙箱/网络/进程树/前端；未重用旧DSH caller作为当前依赖验收。
root独立编码工具MIT，README Studio2.x开发/npm1.x维护；子目录配置包0.1.0固定DSH/provider0.2.1-rc.2非root版本，成品/外部调用端未验。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 模型/机器/隔离未知 | 版本/权限/备份 | root与配置包分开 |
| 持续 | token/重试/工具未知 | diff/测试/审批 | 轮数非费用封顶 |
| 故障 | 外部操作/重试未知 | 查进程/文件/远端 | 取消非回滚 |
| 退出 | 会话/Key/快照留存未知 | VCS/rewind预览和清理 | 只恢复覆盖范围 |
[Q05](#research-q05)低权副本/人类普通输入小改并人工验；外部caller/来源未核不启自动委派，状态不明回IDE/VCS。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 编码循环 | 真Stream/Execute/配对结果 | 合格率/净节时 |
| 权限 | 普通Gate/来源分支存在 | 跨端输入和全工具安全 |
| 预算 | usage/价格与轴条件 | 未知费用/支付硬上限 |
| 恢复 | 文件rename/会话持久路径 | 实际补偿/外部恢复 |
[Q02](#research-q02)干净采样与按ID配对回流；[Q03](#research-q03)来源和权限入口不能混同；[Q04](#research-q04)发布intent/rename补偿及coverage提示可借鉴但非外部事务。
[Q02](#research-q02)实际自主工具执行与配对反馈；[Q04](#research-q04)预算观测/有限文件会话恢复，多入口统一而非新模型。
[Q03](#research-q03)普通Gate不能外推!直输或信任MCP/扩展，外部caller来源未核；[Q04](#research-q04)预算非支付硬预授权、rewind不撤shell/外部效果。
[Q06](#research-q06)人类/委派输入分型与副作用回执，先和禁bash/隔离最小替代对照，不算当前能力。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 必需性 | 用途 | 缺失/边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 根Reasonix成品/模型与Key | 模型任务必需 | 真循环 | 模型接收代码/按服务付费 |
| Go1.26/toolchain | 源构建 | 编译runtime | 配置包不含二进制 |
| 低权副本/VCS/明确权限 | 采用前提 | 控副作用/人审 | rewind不撤shell |
| DSH+ACP provider固定版本 | 委派另需 | 跨端子Agent | caller来源未核不自动委派 |

technical.rationale: Q01/02成熟编码Agent/ACP范式未证新原理novelty0不以入口多加25%；干净采样提交、结果配对、恢复覆盖/预算有机制50%但跨端来源/全副作用未闭环不75%；配对/回执/有限恢复可迁移50%但runtime耦合；多前端/工具简化50%，配置/审查仍重不75%。

business.rationale: Q01/02仅相对人工复制模型建议/手动改测，Agent负责执行、人负责审diff的有限责任分工变化25%；相对已有编码Agent同样的Agent执行/人审基线没有已证分工增量，不主张团队交接或质量闭环50%；Q04直接代码/会话结果交付为便利25%而非已验可用补丁50%；多UI非新服务主体reach0；按provider付费/本地并无供给收费风险转移创新economics0。

recommendation.reason: 能审代码的开发者，可在低权可恢复副本用人类普通输入试一项可验证编码任务。相比手工复制建议，它能真实改测并把结果回流，但!输入、MCP/扩展信任与有限rewind不能概括成统一只读或全撤销。来源、权限或停止后状态不明时应停写并回原IDE/VCS核文件与外部动作，外部调用端未验前不启自动委派。

scenario.rationale: Q01编码小改/人审与基线具体超15；无真实持续任务合格率对照不30。

advantage.rationale: Q02真实循环/结果配对和Q04有限恢复超过接入口6；对现有Agent净优势/权限跨端未验不19。

evidence.rationale: Q02-04 ACP→真provider/Execute/OS shell→结果回流/权限/文件rename恢复已核超片段6；未运行/全工具/外部caller不19。

cost.rationale: Q03-05模型/权限/版本、外部副作用和恢复负担重25%；人类隔离小试退路明确但非完整低门槛50%，现金人工未知。

# DeepSeek Reasonix > 独立多前端编码Agent，通过模型工具循环改文件/验证；另有DSH ACP配置包。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) - **版本号**：未声明（[固定提交 53ca70d347b5aaabe867f355090d32ff12188523](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/53ca70d347b5aaabe867f355090d32ff12188523)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-06（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态支持独立Agent真实循环及有限恢复；低权副本人类小任务受限试用，外部ACP caller未核不推荐自动委派。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：根DeepSeek Reasonix是独立编码Agent/Studio/CLI，提供终端、桌面、Web和ACP编辑器接入；本条身份为root工具，不能将integrations/dsh-plugin的0.1.0当根版本或称整仓DSH原生插件。README区分Studio2.x开发线和npm1.x维护线，根构建有Go1.26/toolchain要求；固定Git源码不等当前发布包/宿主安装通过。 - **亮点**：[Q02](#research-q02)实际自主工具执行与配对反馈；[Q04](#research-q04)预算观测/有限文件会话恢复，多入口统一而非新模型。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03)普通Gate不能外推!直输或信任MCP/扩展，外部caller来源未核；[Q04](#research-q04)预算非支付硬预授权、rewind不撤shell/外部效果。 - **建议**：[Q06](#research-q06)人类/委派输入分型与副作用回执，先和禁bash/隔离最小替代对照，不算当前能力。 采用建议：[Q05](#research-q05)低权副本/人类普通输入小改并人工验；外部caller/来源未核不启自动委派，状态不明回IDE/VCS。 ## 核心贡献 [Q02](#research-q02)实际自主工具执行与配对反馈；[Q04](#research-q04)预算观测/有限文件会话恢复，多入口统一而非新模型。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03)普通Gate不能外推!直输或信任MCP/扩展，外部caller来源未核；[Q04](#research-q04)预算非支付硬预授权、rewind不撤shell/外部效果。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q06](#research-q06)人类/委派输入分型与副作用回执，先和禁bash/隔离最小替代对照，不算当前能力。 只读固定源码，不运行Go/Reasonix/模型/Host/命令/测试或浏览器；无独立任务/安全/费用/恢复或DSH互操作验证。 ## 场景与替代办法 根DeepSeek Reasonix是独立编码Agent/Studio/CLI，提供终端、桌面、Web和ACP编辑器接入；本条身份为root工具，不能将integrations/dsh-plugin的0.1.0当根版本或称整仓DSH原生插件。README区分Studio2.x开发线和npm1.x维护线，根构建有Go1.26/toolchain要求；固定Git源码不等当前发布包/宿主安装通过。 人工复制AI建议/IDE改测或已有编码Agent；模型/OS工具能力已有。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 必需性 | 用途 | 缺失/边界 | |---|---|---|---| | 根Reasonix成品/模型与Key | 模型任务必需 | 真循环 | 模型接收代码/按服务付费 | | Go1.26/toolchain | 源构建 | 编译runtime | 配置包不含二进制 | | 低权副本/VCS/明确权限 | 采用前提 | 控副作用/人审 | rewind不撤shell | | DSH+ACP provider固定版本 | 委派另需 | 跨端子Agent | caller来源未核不自动委派 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 动作 | 判据/失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 准备 | 副本/备份/模型及权限额度 | 不带生产密钥 | | 输入 | 人类普通任务，不用! | 不把委派当人类shell | | 执行 | 读工具/测试结果与diff | 模型答完成非验收 | | 故障 | 查停止/文件/外部效果 | 不盲重跑命令 | | 恢复退出 | 预览rewind覆盖/冲突/VCS | 关会话/凭据，外部人工核 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次 | 模型/机器/隔离未知 | 版本/权限/备份 | root与配置包分开 | | 持续 | token/重试/工具未知 | diff/测试/审批 | 轮数非费用封顶 | | 故障 | 外部操作/重试未知 | 查进程/文件/远端 | 取消非回滚 | | 退出 | 会话/Key/快照留存未知 | VCS/rewind预览和清理 | 只恢复覆盖范围 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 编码循环 | 真Stream/Execute/配对结果 | 合格率/净节时 | | 权限 | 普通Gate/来源分支存在 | 跨端输入和全工具安全 | | 预算 | usage/价格与轴条件 | 未知费用/支付硬上限 | | 恢复 | 文件rename/会话持久路径 | 实际补偿/外部恢复 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：重核根ACP/Agent真实执行、不同来源权限、预算和有限恢复，不将配置包等同安全委派验收。 ### Q01 · 根Reasonix与DSH配置包是什么关系，谁能用它完成什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 根DeepSeek Reasonix是独立编码Agent/Studio/CLI，提供终端、桌面、Web和ACP编辑器接入；本条身份为root工具，不能将integrations/dsh-plugin的0.1.0当根版本或称整仓DSH原生插件。README区分Studio2.x开发线和npm1.x维护线，根构建有Go1.26/toolchain要求；固定Git源码不等当前发布包/宿主安装通过。 目标是能审代码的人在可恢复项目描述小任务，让Agent读取、改文件并执行验证，再由人接手验收。基线为人工复制模型建议/IDE手动改测，或已有编码Agent。贡献是模型↔真实工具↔会话反馈和多前端统一，不是新推理模型；模型服务接收代码、凭据/费用由使用者配置。DSH子目录只是配置：启动reasonix acp并接官方provider，固定dsh/provider0.2.1-rc.2和permission:reject，根工具/模型Key仍需另装配置。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:44-76](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/53ca70d347b5aaabe867f355090d32ff12188523/README.md#L44-L76) 作者独立编码Agent/模型接收代码与文件恢复边界。

Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

\n

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

\n

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

\n

Maintained by Huahui Yu.

\n\n## What it is\n\nReasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step.\n\nYou pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly.\n\n## What you get\n\n- **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder.\n- **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve.\n- **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did.\n\n## 30-second start\n\nDownload, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.\n\n1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the [releases page](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true).\n2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked.\n3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example \"add retry on failure to the http client\".\n4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse.\n\nPrefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start).\n\n## Four ways to use it\n\n- **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start.\n- **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run \"task\"` also works in scripts.\n- **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine.\n- **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`.\n\nAll four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors.\n\n## Use it from DeepSeek Harness\n\nDeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it:\n\n1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json`\n2. Install \"Reasonix subagent\" from it.\n3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one.\n\nSetup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md).\n\n## Versions\n\nReasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split.\n\n| Line | Branch | Status | Get it |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) |\n| **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) |\n\n- **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes,\n provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture\n is no longer being extended.\n- **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving\n quickly; reports are welcome.\n\nValuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported\nor reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture.\n\n- [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and\n how to run both on one machine without losing sessions.\n- [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships,\n and the decisions still open.\n\n## Features\n\nTechnical highlights for advanced users.\n\n- **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all\n declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models.\n- **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any\n OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run\n two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions.\n- **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources;\n Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute\n Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages.\n- **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment\n summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the\n built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review.\n- **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile\n to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static\n binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself.\n\n## Install\n\nThis branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI,\nStudio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine.\n\n### Reasonix Studio (2.x)\n\nDownload the package for your platform from the latest\n[Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true)\n(tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as\npre-releases):\n\n| Platform | Package | Architecture |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) |\n| Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 |\n| Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) |\n\nEvery package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries\n`SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place.\n\nThe same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for\n`darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`.\n\nThe Android build ships on that release as `ReasonixMobile-.apk`\n(`arm64`, Android 8.0 or newer). The kernel and the page run on the phone, and\nthe agent reaches your servers over SSH; pairing with a computer is done by\nscanning the code it shows.\n\nThe APK is signed with the Android release key rather than minisign, so it\ncarries a `.sha256` and no `.minisig`.\n\nWhen that key is absent the build is named\n`ReasonixMobile--unsigned.apk`. Android refuses to install an unsigned\npackage, so those builds stay a workflow artifact for whoever wants to sign one,\nand the release carries no APK at all.\n\n### Reasonix 1.x (stable)\n\nThe 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on\nmacOS:\n\n```sh\nnpm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary\nbrew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS\n```\n\nThe 1.x desktop app is on the\n[official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows\ninstallers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate.\n\n### VS Code extension\n\nThe extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp`\nbackend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model\nselection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first.\n\n- **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent)\n- **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent)\n- **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode)\n\n### Build from source\n\nClone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x:\n\n```sh\ngit clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git\ncd DeepSeek-Reasonix\ngit switch studio\n```\n\n#### CLI\n\nThe CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive;\nkeep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it.\n\n```sh\nmake build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe)\nmake cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64)\n```\n\n#### Studio\n\nStudio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10**\n(`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend.\n\n```sh\nmake studio\n```\n\nSee the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform\nwebview dependencies and Linux build tags.\n\n## Quick start\n\n### Reasonix Studio\n\nInstall and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI\nsetup is needed.\n\n### CLI / TUI\n\n```sh\nreasonix setup # configure a provider and model\nreasonix # start an interactive session\nreasonix run \"implement the TODOs in main.go\"\n```\n\nIn an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project\ninstructions.\n\nFor advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**,\n**[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and\n**[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**.\n\n## Documentation\n\n- **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) ·\n [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) ·\n [Use from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md)\n- **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) ·\n [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) ·\n [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) ·\n [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) ·\n [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md)\n- **Agent presets:** [Session Agent compositions](./docs/AGENT_COMPOSITIONS.md)\n- **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) ·\n [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) ·\n [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) ·\n [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md)\n- **Extension development:** [Skills](./docs/SKILLS.md) · [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) ·\n [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) ·\n [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) ·\n [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md)\n\n## Star History\n\n\n \n \n \n \n \n\n\n

"---\nowner: @esengine\nbackup: @SivanCola\nstatus: active\nreviewed: 2026-10-17\n---\n\n# dsh-plugin-reasonix\n\nEnglish | [中文](#中文)\n\n[Website](https://reasonix.io) · [Documentation](../../docs/DSH.md) · [Source](../../README.md)\n\nUse [Reasonix](../../README.md) as a subagent in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). The package is configuration only: one patch layer that points Harness's `subagent-acp` provider at `reasonix acp` and exposes it to the model as a `reasonix` tool. It contains no code.\n\n## Before you install\n\n1. Install Reasonix and run `reasonix setup` once on the same machine. Reasonix reads its provider key from its own home, not from environment variables, so Harness cannot pass one.\n2. Make sure `reasonix` is on the `PATH` of the process that runs `dsh`.\n\n## Install\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin\n```\n\nThe package is not on npm; `pnpm` installs the `integrations/dsh-plugin` subdirectory of this repository (the `path:` selector, see [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)).\n\n## After installing: switch it on\n\nAn installed plugin starts **off**. Open its page in the DSH Web UI and turn the switch on.\n\n- The switch and both components must read Running. Turning it on in a running `dsh web` is enough: the next new session has the `reasonix` tool (observed on `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2). Restart `dsh` only if it is still missing.\n- While it is off the model may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell.\n- That looks like a delegation and is not one: there is no subagent, and the permission policy below does not apply.\n\n## What it changes\n\n| Row | Effect |\n| --- | --- |\n| `subagent-acp-reasonix` | Spawns `reasonix acp` for each delegation; `permission: reject`. |\n| `tool-subagent-reasonix` | Adds the `reasonix` tool (`prompt`, `description`, optional `cwd`); `maxDepth: provider-managed`, which the provider requires. |\n\n## Permissions\n\n- `permission: reject` is the default. Every approval card Reasonix raises is declined, so the child can read and research but cannot write files or run commands that need approval.\n- `permission: allow` makes Harness accept every card automatically. The delegated task can then do anything Reasonix's tools can do in that workspace.\n- Change the policy only in your own `cordis.patch.yml`, for a task and workspace you would approve wholesale.\n\nDetails, what the parent receives, and limits: [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md).\n\n## Versions\n\nThe provider version must equal your `dsh` version. This release pins `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2.\n\n---\n\n## 中文\n\n[官网](https://reasonix.io) · [文档](../../docs/DSH.md) · [源码](../../README.md)\n\n把 [Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) 作为子智能体接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）。本包只有配置，没有代码：一层补丁，让 Harness 的 `subagent-acp` 提供方去启动 `reasonix acp`，并以 `reasonix` 工具的形式暴露给模型。\n\n**安装前**\n\n1. 在同一台机器上安装 Reasonix 并运行一次 `reasonix setup`。Reasonix 只从自己的主目录读取模型密钥，不读环境变量，所以 Harness 无法替它传密钥。\n2. 保证运行 `dsh` 的进程的 `PATH` 里有 `reasonix`。\n\n**安装**\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin\n```\n\n包不在 npm 上：`pnpm` 通过 `path:` 选择器安装本仓库的 `integrations/dsh-plugin` 子目录（见 [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)）。\n\n**安装后：打开开关**\n\n插件装好后默认是“关闭”的。到 DSH Web 界面的插件页打开它的开关。\n\n- 开关和两个组件都显示 Running 才算生效。在运行中的 `dsh web` 里直接打开就够了，下一个新会话里就有 `reasonix` 工具（在 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 上实测）；仍然没有再重启 `dsh`。\n- 没打开时，模型可能改在自己的 shell 里直接运行 `reasonix -p`。\n- 这看起来像委派，其实不是：没有子智能体，下面的权限策略也不起作用。\n\n**权限**\n\n- 默认 `permission: reject`：Reasonix 弹出的每个审批卡都会被拒绝，子智能体只能读和调研，不能写文件或执行需要批准的命令。\n- `permission: allow` 会让 Harness 自动同意所有审批卡，被委派的任务可以在该工作区里做 Reasonix 工具能做的任何事。\n- 只在你自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，为你愿意整体放行的任务和工作区才改成 `allow`。\n\n详细说明见 [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md)。\n\n**版本**：提供方版本必须与你的 `dsh` 版本一致，本版本固定为 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2。\n" }, { "path": "integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml", "content": "- insert:\n -
